# LAWS_DIGEST (generated by law-lint.cjs digest; never edit by hand)
source_hash: a683f2f1c159e3d865e1482ecefa9a57b8cf7f612681c24ed5d29786b040b028
One line per law; the full law in LAWS.md has the same number.
1. **The Master plans everything and picks the cheapest path.** Script, scout, itself, a subagent (at most 2; audits excepted, with a budget), then a worker chat (`core/TOKENS.md`).
2. **The Master sets each worker's tier and effort.** Briefs name tiers, never models (`MODELS.md`).
3. **Two-way talk, never broadcast.** Messages go direct by chat name, as a RESULT (`core/RESULT.md`).
4. **Pipeline.** Research, LOCK, brief, build and test, compare, merge.
5. **Reuse workers.** When green the Master sends `RESET`; the worker finalises its handoff and clears itself.
6. **History first.** Before planning, grep `handoffs/` (with `archive/`, `pairs/`), `FEATURE_INDEX.md` and `ACTION_LOG*`.
7. **Each chat tests only its own scope; the top chat tests the whole.** A worker or subagent: type-check, the tests its change affects and its own flow, never the full suite.
8. **After the sweep.** Red: the same worker fixes its failures in its own chat until green; green: `RESET`.
9. **Workers ask only the Master.** No worker talks to another unless the Master pairs them (`handoffs/pairs/<id>-<id>.md`).
10. **No free worker: open one within capacity.** Law 26; sizing and waves: `core/SCALE.md`.
11. **Token and tier choices are automatic.** The Master has full authority over workers.
12. **Context.** Chief and Masters roll over at `250k` unless the human set another number (`core/CHIEF.md` rule 1).
13. **One report after a full E2E (the top chat).** What merged, test numbers, what was NOT tested (a clean type check is not a live check), any action for the human; progress stays on the BOARD.
14. **Usage window.** Each cycle and before each wave, `scripts/cycle.cjs` applies the TOKENS §6 table (5-hour and weekly).
15. **Workers use the minimal-change approach.** Lean, for simple tasks and bugfixes.
16. **Two phases per High-tier module.** Phase 1 builds and bugfixes, then clears; phase 2 optimises, at most 2 passes.
17. **Docs are at most 200 lines each.** Project and master-brain files (law 19).
18. **Several Masters can run at once.** Each owns its area (BOARD Masters table); a Chief sits above them, messaged only for done, blocked or needs-chief (CHIEF rule 2); agreements in `handoffs/pairs/C1-M#.md`.
19. **Split rule.** A `.md` over 200 lines keeps H1, intro and a § table and moves sections verbatim to `<name>/NN-topic.md`; logs roll into dated parts; old handoff entries go to `handoffs/archive/`.
20. **Approval gates.** `core/SAFETY.md` 12, also when the arena skill triggers by itself (procedure/05).
21. **Test integrity.** Snapshot with `scripts/test-guard.cjs` before a worker starts and compare before merge: no merge on removed tests, new skips or fewer assertions, and for a build or bugfix none without a new te...
22. **Security gate.** No merge while a confirmed high or critical finding is open; each gets a regression test.
23. **Tools by logical name.** Mapped in `CAPABILITIES.md`; an UNKNOWN is never guessed.
24. **Improvement loop.** After each task, `scripts/route-log.cjs from-result <handoff>`; every ~10 tasks, `route-stats.cjs` proposals, one change at a time, with the human's yes (`core/IMPROVE.md`).
25. **Optional footer.** Off unless the human chose it (`{{footer on|off}}`); when on, every reply ends with 6 lines or fewer: open decisions and what others owe (procedure/04).
26. **Chat capacity.** A task starts only when `scripts/capacity.cjs load` says it fits (`CAPACITY.md`; `cycle.cjs` shows the room).
